acceptanceResults.evidence: Exact GET path, closed query, population-bound catalog, freshness and signed request-bound cursor are covered by API, service and PostgreSQL tests.
Exact POST path enforces all required headers including single bounded step-up challenge, strict duplicate/trailing-token JSON and bounded request streaming; returns 202 Receipt.
Carrier PEP plus Gateway context projection and runtime repository predicates enforce app, duty, capability, population, field and fixed purpose intersections.
Tenant and principal are server-owned; RLS and exact population kind/digest predicates deny cross-tenant and cross-population reads.
Canonical tenant/owner/client-key replay precedes external calls; same subject+digest replays, payload mismatch and cross-subject reuse return opaque 409.
Object version, ETag, digest, size, media and signed CLEAN scan evidence are bound and every tested mismatch fails before receipt creation.
Direction derives from transferKind; all outbound kinds require a verified recipient policy and positive egress revision.
V328 trigger enforces legal CAS transitions, lease rules, expiry time, terminal immutability and delete denial with PostgreSQL evidence.
Shared receipt seals the controlled-transfer origin and reapplies the restrictive current/origin decision; revoke, expiry, route, purpose and seal mismatch fail closed.
SYS-EVT-008 is written through the transactional outbox with the typed minimized contract and deterministic event identity.
V328 clean and V327-to-V328 PostgreSQL Testcontainers paths pass with V327 checksum preservation, forced RLS, constraints and tenant/population negative probes.
Runtime, authority clients and authorization bundle remain default OFF/DRAFT; no tenant, customer or production activation is included.
